en: Black-and-white image showing a large medieval hilltop complex with two tall, slender towers with steep pointed roofs, part of a fortified structure above a river. Below the fortress are several villas or houses on the riverbank, and the entire scene is reflected clearly in the calm water. Trees frame the right side of the image. The photo has an old, slightly damaged look, and faint handwritten characters appear at the bottom edge of the image.
